page_note: Page contains end of preceding chapter (Watchers/Giants narrative) and the opening of Kephalaion 47 'Concerning the Ambassador.' The teaching follows a recurring substratic temporal-pattern formula: 'Beforehand, before X manifested in the cosmos, they sent forth Y' — applied iteratively to (a) the Watchers/Giants → prison, (b) night/day separation → Third Ambassador and ships of light, (c) the Judge in the living air, (d) Error and scandal of doctrines → Christ, (e) the begetting of men. The fatigue score detects polemic-vocabulary drift in the second half (ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ, ⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ, ⲡⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ), but these terms occur WITHIN the substrate's own structural pattern rather than as contemporary identifications — they describe cosmic-historical Error and the cosmic figure of Christ-the-Judge, not named contemporary sects. Editorial frame is confined to the chapter heading and the standard 'Once again, hear this other word' formula.
